from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Adding vectors is like following sequential instructions.",
            "Place the second vector's tail at the first's tip.",
            "The result is the arrow from start to end.",
            "Numerically, we simply add the corresponding components.",
            "This new vector represents the combined total movement."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Vector Addition: The Tip-to-Tail Method", lecture_lines)

        # Colors
        COLOR_PLANE = "#1E90FF"
        COLOR_WIND = "#FF00FF"
        COLOR_RESULTANT = "#FFFF00"
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = YELLOW

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Introductory line
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR))
        self.wait(1.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Draw Plane and Wind vectors
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(COLOR_WIND)
        )
        
        # Positions
        plane_start = self.grid["D2"]
        plane_end = self.grid["D4"]
        wind_start = plane_end
        wind_end = self.grid["B4"]
        
        # Plane Vector
        plane_vec = Arrow(plane_start, plane_end, buff=0, color=COLOR_PLANE)
        plane_label = Text("Plane", font_size=20, color=COLOR_PLANE)
        self.place_at_grid(plane_label, "E3", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Wind Vector
        wind_vec = Arrow(wind_start, wind_end, buff=0, color=COLOR_WIND)
        wind_label = Text("Wind", font_size=20, color=COLOR_WIND)
        self.place_at_grid(wind_label, "C5", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(Create(plane_vec), Write(plane_label))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Create(wind_vec), Write(wind_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Draw Resultant vector
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(COLOR_RESULTANT)
        )
        
        res_vec = Arrow(plane_start, wind_end, buff=0, color=COLOR_RESULTANT)
        res_label = Text("Resultant", font_size=20, color=COLOR_RESULTANT)
        self.place_at_grid(res_label, "C2", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(Create(res_vec), Write(res_label))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Numerical addition
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(COLOR_RESULTANT)
        )
        
        # Math: [2, 0] + [0, 2] = [2, 2]
        math_addition = MathTex(
            r"\begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}", 
            "+", 
            r"\begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix}", 
            "=", 
            r"\begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ 2 \end{bmatrix}",
            font_size=32
        )
        # Apply colors to components
        math_addition[0].set_color(COLOR_PLANE)
        math_addition[2].set_color(COLOR_WIND)
        math_addition[4].set_color(COLOR_RESULTANT)
        
        self.place_in_area(math_addition, "F2", "F5", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        self.play(Write(math_addition))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Conclusion
        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR)
        )
        
        # Visual emphasis on the resultant vector
        self.play(Flash(res_vec, color=COLOR_RESULTANT, line_length=0.3, flash_radius=0.4))
        self.wait(2)
